statement.notes: 1) 'total_operating_cost' includes all operating expenses that reduce income: Cost of sales, Marketing and selling expenses, General and administrative expenses, and Other operating income and expenses (as a positive cost). Income/(Loss) from joint ventures and associates is an income item, so it is included as a negative cost (i.e., a reduction to total operating cost). 2) 'interest_expenses' includes Cost of net financial debt and Interest on lease liabilities. Other financial income and expenses is not included as it is a net figure containing non-interest items. 3) 'net_income' is 'Net profit, Group share'. 4) 'taxes' is 'Income taxes'. 5) All values are taken directly from the primary statement; parentheses indicate negatives. 6) The supplementary tables provide detailed breakdowns but are not used for aggregation per the rules.
